facial_animation_notes: The husband's face (long wedge-shaped nose, round black-frame glasses) holds a single wide-open-mouth 'gasp' shape across multiple consecutive periodic frames (periodic-9, 10, 11) while only the eyes and brow shift -- mouth geometry does not appear to lip-sync to the dialogue ('you', 'GOAALLL!!!', 'okay?') in these frames, suggesting held mouth poses punctuated by eye/brow acting rather than full phoneme-driven lip sync. gesture_notes: The husband's hand is planted on the wife's torso/chest across the collapse sequence (periodic-4 through periodic-7) with almost no repositioning -- a held static gesture rather than continuously animated hand acting. The wife's arms and legs are strewn limply on the floor with fingers slightly curled, consistent with a 'ragdoll' rigged pose rather than per-frame hand-sculpted adjustments.
idle_motion_notes: Background elements carry the ambient motion load: the TV plays a looping soccer match with a moving ball and players (visible score/graphic changes from 0-0 to 3-3 across frames), and lamps hold steady practical-light glow -- the human characters themselves show almost no idle secondary motion (no breathing sway, no cloth settle) during the held reaction poses, so 'idle' motion here is offloaded to the screen-within-screen rather than the puppets.
frame_rate_feel: Source is 30fps per metadata.json.
